title: Author Content Consistency
scenario: For each author, find the longest consecutive streak of days they published at least one article.
hint: Create groups by subtracting row number from date.
correctQuery: SELECT author_id, MAX(streak) FROM (SELECT author_id, COUNT(*) as streak FROM (SELECT author_id, publish_date, (publish_date - ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY author_id ORDER BY publish_date)::INT) as grp FROM (SELECT DISTINCT author_id, publish_date FROM articles) t) t2 GROUP BY author_id, grp) t3 GROUP BY author_id;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE articles (author_id INT, publish_date DATE);
